# Can all WBC kinematics and dynamics algorithms be assumed supported after mimic joint parsing in Pinocchio?

> **Current answer:** Not. The original thread explicitly stated that not all features are available. Pinocchio v3.5.0 only lists the mimic parameter (default false) for buildModel, and forward kinematics, Jacobians/frames, ccrba, RNEA, CRBA, and reachable workspace mimic support. Engineering practice should pass mimic=True and verify algorithm by version release; continuous mimic URDF parsing requires v3.8.0/#2756.

## Key terms

- Actuator DOF (mimic joint) (从动关节)
- Referent DOF (referent joint) (参考关节)
- Inverse Dynamics (RNEA) (逆动力学)
- Composite Rigid Body Algorithm (CRBA) (复合刚体算法)
- Centroidal Composite Rigid Body Algorithm (ccrba) (质心刚体算法)

## Problem and symptoms

- What WBC algorithms are explicitly supported from which Pinocchio version onwards?
- Users cannot confirm whether forward dynamics, FK, IK/Jacobian, etc., automatically comply with referent-mimic constraints.

## Environment

- Originates from 2020 legacy versions; closed with Pinocchio 3.5.0 and PR #2441.

## Priority diagnostics

- Verify URDF parser switch, mimic/mimicked list in model, and whether target algorithm is listed in corresponding version release.

## Possible causes

- Historical versions did not provide complete delivery of mimic joint data structure, parser entry, and algorithm coverage; maintainer also warned that not all features are available.

## Attempts

- Maintainer and users discussed whether to remove actuator DOF from final user state, and expectations for FK/FD/ID constraints.
- Maintainer merged PR #2441 in 2025.

## Effective fixes

- Use buildModel(..., mimic=True) in Pinocchio 3.5.0 or later to parse mimic fields, and only list FK, Jacobian, ccrba, RNEA, CRBA, and reachable workspace in v3.5.0 release.

## Result

- Maintainer stated in 2025-03-03 that issue closed and issue resolved; v3.5.0 release lists parsing API, supported algorithms, and new model data field.

## Limitations

- Original thread explicitly stated not all Pinocchio features are available for mimic; algorithms not listed in v3.5.0 release cannot be inferred as supported.
- Continuous mimic URDF parsing requires v3.8.0/#2756, not just general support declaration from v3.5.0.

## Safety notes

- Before real-world WBC, verify each algorithm for mimic constraint regression and ensure state/force vector dimensions do not treat actuator DOF as independent executors.
